trigger: Use only if a later access-capable recovery investigation confirms that the historical package cannot be recovered sufficiently and an explicit issue authorizes a new empirical object.
why_not_started: Blocked access to legitimate GitHub project-history and authoritative-source surfaces prevents a final irrecoverability finding. This task does not authorize acquisition.

historical_identities_to_preserve.rule: Unknown historical digests, sizes, row counts, timestamps, and schema identities remain null and must never be overwritten with new values.

new_object_requirements.acquisition_identity: Assign an identity explicitly distinct from the historical canonical package.
new_object_requirements.retrieval_timestamps: Record new acquisition start, every retrieval, and completion timestamp.
new_object_requirements.source_and_schema_binding: Bind dataset az4n-8mr2, source URLs, rowsUpdatedAt stability checks, exact schema source content digest, and schema binding digest.
new_object_requirements.manifest: Create a new manifest containing query, strict ordering, pagination, retry, serialization, page provenance, row count, byte size, exact frame SHA-256, and all schema relationships.
new_object_requirements.complete_frame_digest: Compute SHA-256 over the exact newly published bytes; do not compare or alias it to an unknown historical digest.
new_object_requirements.audit: Run the existing canonical fail-closed audit unchanged and preserve its machine-readable result bound to the new frame, manifest, and schema.
new_object_requirements.field_semantics: Preserve authoritative definitions and code meanings with source identities and retrieval evidence before any eligibility predicate is authorized.
new_object_requirements.provenance: Record the authorizing issue, acquisition command/version, execution environment, source locators, retrieval results, timestamps, and limitations.
new_object_requirements.distinction: Every new artifact and status record must state that it is a new live-source empirical object and not byte-identical historical recovery.

prohibited_transition: historical object unavailable -> download current data -> label it historical recovery
